title: Midday Sunwatch
text:
🌤️ Midday Sunwatch — October 02, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B2.3)
🔥 Latest solar flare: C1.4 (Peaked October 01, 2026 at 21:37 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 282 km/s (Calm)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 0.67)
🚨 NOAA Alert: Electron 2MeV Integral Flux exceeded 1,000pfu

Space around the satellites is looking lively! 📡🔋🌞

Images: NOAA GOES-19 SUVI — 195, 284, 171, 304, 131, 094 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
